entry.title: Prompt Injection: The Breach We Can't Patch
entry.summary: We’re treating Large Language Models (LLMs) like traditional software. We think if we just wrap them in enough API layers and filters, they’ll be secure. But LLMs have a fundamental design flaw that makes them a security nightmare. The instructions (the code) and the user input (the data) are processed in the same channel. There is no separation. This isn't a bug you can fix with a software update. It’s how technology works. The SQL Injection of the AI Era In the old days, we had SQL injection. A user could type a command into a login box and drop your entire database. We fixed that by separating the command from the data. In AI, that's impossible.
